content.scenario: The Central Government appoints an Assistant Director to assist in conducting inquiries or investigations under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The Assistant Director exercises his powers and discharges his functions subject to the general control, supervision, and direction of the Director-General, while conducting inquiries or investigations under the Act.

user_queries: What are the powers of the Assistant Director?
Can the Director-General delegate powers to the Assistant Director?
What is the role of the Assistant Director in investigations?
